notes:
**Fix: Windows in-app updater actually installs the new version**

- **UAC/install wait** — use `Start-Process -Verb RunAs -Wait` (old `ProcessStartInfo` returned before install finished)
- **Install path** — read Inno Setup `InstallLocation` from registry (not only `exe` parent folder)
- **Progress window** — do not kill `--update-status` helper when stopping app instances
- **Staged installer** — copy Setup.exe to `%LOCALAPPDATA%/AssetValidator/updates/`
- **Startup warning** — show dialog if
